messages:
Maya: Quick PSA — kb-scan found 4 orphan shortlinks in /runtime/pagination.md when I was validating the new cursor example.
Maya: ripgrep snippet I ran:
```
ripgrep -n "https?://(short|bit|s\.red)" content/runtime/pagination.md
```
Maya: lines ~45-60 show two inline shortlinks that 404 in staging (one is a tiny gist, the other an internal shortlink that resolves to a deleted shortlink).
Jon: which shortlinks? can you paste the URLs?
Maya: sure: `https://s.red/xyz123` and `https://short.red/runtime-bits` (both 404 on staging).
Sam: I can take this. quick question: do we prefer rehost to our gist store or swap to full canonical links?
Lee: for tiny code snippets we prefer to rehost under /_assets/gists/ (keeps external deps limited) and add alttext. if it’s a larger sample, link to the canonical runtime repo.
Maya: gist is tiny (~20 lines). propose rehost + replace shortlink with /_assets/gists/pagination-cursor.js and update the anchor text. For the internal shortlink, owner is ambiguous; CODEOWNERS shows `/docs/runtime/` -> eng-runtime. @eng-runtime any objections?
kb-bot: scan: 4 orphan/shortlink warnings in runtime/pagination.md (see CI report https://ci.redwood-inference/internal-scans/1765432188)
Olivia: no objections — rehost is fine. if you rehost, add a brief caption mentioning original gist author.
Sam: grabbing it now. will rehost gist file and open a tiny PR. tagging @olivia for review once ready.
Sam: opening PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — changes: rehost gist to /_assets/gists/pagination-cursor.js, replace shortlink, and update alt/caption. diff is two lines.
Sam: quick patch I ran locally (example):
```
for f in content/runtime/pagination.md; do 
  sed -i "s|https://s.red/xyz123|/_assets/gists/pagination-cursor.js|g" $f; 
  sed -i "s|https://short.red/runtime-bits|https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/blob/main/examples/pagination.md|g" $f;
done
```
Sam: PR is assigned to @olivia and CC @maya for verification.
Jon: I'll run a local build and smoke test on staging once the PR is up.

Maya: checked staging — links resolve, no 404s. gist rehosted and caption looks good. thanks @sam :thumbsup:
Sam: merging PR now.
Sam: merged PR #4321 and triggered site rebuild.

deploy-bot: site rebuild complete — production updated (https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/pagination)
Maya: closing the thread — everything validated on prod. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :pray:
